name: ListDoctorComputeSummary

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the request to retrieve a new page of results
parameters.help_zh: 标记当前开始读取的位置
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return on each page
parameters.help_zh: 一次获取的最大记录数
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: Specify the date in the ISO 8601 standard. For example, 2023-01-01 represents January 1, 2023
parameters.help_zh: 其日期和时间信息以 ISO 8601 格式表示， 例如：2023年1月1日为2023-01-01
parameters.name: date_time

parameters.help_en:
The resource types, which are used to filter query results. Valid values:

engine: filters results by engine.
queue: filters results by queue.
cluster: displays the results at the cluster level.

If you do not specify this parameter, the information at the cluster level is displayed by default. Currently, only one resource type is supported. If you specify multiple resource types, the first resource type is used by default
parameters.help_zh:
过滤资源的类型。取值：
engine：通过引擎类型来过滤结果。
queue：通过队列来过滤结果。
cluster：展示整个集群结果。   

如果不填写，默认展示整个集群信息。目前只支持单资源类型，填写多个资源类型会默认取第一个资源类型
parameters.name: component_types

parameters.help_en:
The order in which you want to sort the query results. Valid values:

ASC: in ascending order.
DESC: in descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序方向。取值：

ASC：升序排列。

DESC：降序排列
parameters.name: order_type

parameters.help_en:
The basis on which you want to sort the query results. Valid values:

vcoreSeconds: the total CPU consumption over time in seconds.
memSeconds: the total memory consumption over time in seconds.
vcoreUtilization: the average CPU utilization. The meaning is the same as the %CPU parameter in the output of the top command in Linux.
memUtilization: the average memory usage.
vcoreSecondsDayGrowthRatio: the day-to-day growth rate of the total CPU consumption over time in seconds.
memSecondsDayGrowthRatio: the day-to-day growth rate of the total memory consumption over time in seconds.
readSize: the total amount of data read from the file system.
writeSize: the total amount of data written to the file system.
healthyJobCount: the total number of healthy jobs.
subHealthyJobCount: the total number of sub-healthy jobs.
unhealthyJobCount: the total number of unhealthy jobs.
needAttentionJobCount: the total number of jobs that require attention.
score: the score for jobs.
scoreDayGrowthRatio: the day-to-day growth rate of the score for jobs
parameters.help_zh:
排序顺序。取值：
vcoreSeconds：资源CPU使用总量。
memSeconds：资源内存使用总量。
vcoreUtilization：资源平均CPU使用率。同Linux Top的%CPU含义。
memUtilization：资源平均内存利用率。
vcoreSecondsDayGrowthRatio：资源CPU使用总量日环比。
memSecondsDayGrowthRatio：资源内存使用总量日环比。
readSize：资源读取文件系统总量。
writeSize：资源写入文件系统总量。
healthyJobCount：健康任务总数。
subHealthyJobCount：亚健康任务总数。
unhealthyJobCount：不健康任务总数。
needAttentionJobCount：需要关注的任务总数。
score：资源任务评分。
scoreDayGrowthRatio：资源任务评分日环比
parameters.name: order_by
